prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a single extremely polished high-fidelity desktop homepage redesign screenshot for LumioAPI, a unified AI API gateway. Landscape wide 16:9, ideally 2048x1152. This is concept A: "NEBULA / 深空星云". A premium cinematic website with immersive AI-generated deep space imagery, profound infinite depth, atmospheric cinematic realism, precise beautiful functional web typography. This is a finished webpage screenshot edge to edge, NOT a poster, NOT a device mockup, no outside borders or scene captions.
BACKGROUND: Original spectacular astrophotographic swirling violet, indigo and electric-blue nebula crossing the left and middle of the screen, fine luminous gas filaments, gorgeous volumetric dust, countless TINY stars at many depths, an abyss of navy black space. A curved luminous nebula creates an expansive, receding open tunnel in the center-left, suggesting an endless universe. Preserve very dark, calm negative space behind all typography and especially on the right. Sophisticated restrained blues and lilacs, luminous highlights only in cosmic structures, 70% dark overall. No planet, no astronaut, no spacecraft, no cartoon, no generic smooth gradient substitute. The background must feel alive and suitable for slow drifting parallax animation.
LAYOUT: slim transparent navigation 80px tall with a subtle bottom hairline. Top left text "LumioAPI" beside a small simple violet-cyan luminous symbol. Top center/right understated navigation "首页", "模型广场", "文档", "关于". Far right a small outlined "控制台 ↗" link. Spacious professional alignment and generous padding.
Left content begins at x=110, in middle-upper part of page: small letterspaced eyebrow "ONE API. INFINITE POSSIBILITIES." then very large elegant bold Chinese headline on two lines EXACTLY "连接智能，" and "探索无限。" in crisp ivory white; second line very pale lavender. Under headline a legible two-line Chinese description "一个 API，连接海量 AI 模型。" then "让每一次创造，都通向更远的宇宙。" restrained silver. Below, an understated text link "探索模型 →". Lower left three subtle widely separated mini-features "统一接口" "多模型接入" "按量计费" with tiny separators, not stat cards. A little deep-space coordinate-like detail at lower center may read "EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN".
RIGHT: one perfectly readable rounded dark smoked-glass authentication card, x around 1320 on a 2048 canvas, width 540, height 660, vertically centered, with subtle thin cool white border and subtle nebula light reflected along left edge. Do NOT fill with noisy stars. Professional real UI, dark opaque-enough background. Inside ample 40px padding: segmented tabs "登录" (active) and "注册"; header "欢迎回来", subtitle "登录 LumioAPI，开启你的 AI 之旅"; labelled input "用户名或邮箱" with placeholder "请输入用户名或邮箱"; labelled input "密码" with concealed dots and a small eye outline; small right-aligned "忘记密码？"; broad violet-blue luminous button "登录 →"; divider "或使用以下方式继续"; two tasteful outline secondary buttons "GitHub" and "通行密钥"; tiny footer "继续即表示你同意 服务条款 和 隐私政策". Keep all text sharp, correct and legible, elegant contemporary UI font, consistent 8px spacing system. The form is the second focus, nebula and left headline first.
BOTTOM: tiny subtle footer "Powered by new-api · QuantumNous" at left and "让智能触手可及" at right. No invented usage metrics, no charts, no terminal widget, no giant glowing UI borders. Highest-end editorial and cinematic web design.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one premium photorealistic cinematic high-fidelity Chinese desktop homepage screenshot for LumioAPI, a unified AI API gateway. Landscape 2048x1152. Full website screenshot edge to edge, no device frame, no presentation-board labels. Use original spectacular AIGC cosmic imagery with convincing infinite depth, carefully art-directed dark negative space behind text. Pixel-perfect clean readable Chinese UI, editorial typography and professional 8px spacing. No terminal/code demo, no made-up metrics, no stock-watermark, no spacecraft/astronauts, no cartoon. This is a style reference for a site whose cosmic background will eventually be animated; the UI stays still.
Navigation: slim transparent header, brand "LumioAPI" left beside a tiny violet/cyan symbol; restrained links "首页" "模型广场" "文档" "关于"; outlined "控制台 ↗" at right.
Left typography: small uppercase eyebrow "ONE API. INFINITE POSSIBILITIES.", then large exquisite bold Chinese headline on two lines exactly "连接智能，" / "探索无限。"; readable subtitle "一个 API，连接海量 AI 模型。" / "让每一次创造，都通向更远的宇宙。"; subtle text link "探索模型 →". Below put small separated feature labels "统一接口" "多模型接入" "按量计费", not three cards.
Right: one practical polished authentication card, roughly 27% page width, vertically centered, with consistent ample inner padding and substantial readable text. All text must sit on calm dark backgrounds. Segmented tabs "登录" (selected) and "注册"; title "欢迎回来"; subtitle "登录 LumioAPI，开启你的 AI 之旅"; field label "用户名或邮箱" / placeholder "请输入用户名或邮箱"; label "密码" / masked dots with subtle eye icon; right-aligned "忘记密码？"; large primary button "登录 →"; separator "或使用以下方式继续"; secondary buttons "GitHub" and "通行密钥"; small footer "继续即表示你同意 服务条款 和 隐私政策". Realistic visual form, no duplicate extra fields.
Tiny page footer at left "Powered by new-api · QuantumNous"; bottom right "让智能触手可及".
ART DIRECTION B — EVENT HORIZON, amber gravitational abyss. Genuinely distinct from a colorful nebula theme: near-monochrome obsidian black and champagne amber, very cinematic, grand cosmic scale, warm ivory typographic details, clean architectural restraint. A huge scientifically inspired black hole anchored around 40% horizontally and 55% vertically, luminous intricate accretion disk tilted dramatically from lower left toward upper middle, subtle gravitational lensing halo bends over the enormous black circular void. Finely detailed amber dust and copper-gold particles disappear into infinity. Preserve black hole central void clearly visible; place left headline in the dark upper-left with ample breathing room, never on the brightest disk. Make the accretion disk stretch behind lower-left supporting copy but retain excellent contrast through thoughtful composition. 80% of screen very dark, stars delicate, vast emptiness, no overly orange entire screen. Card on right in solid smoked obsidian, less transparent, 16px corner radius, an exquisite hairline bronze border with a restrained lit left edge; tab highlight and primary button muted champagne gold with dark text. Form calm and rock-solid. Sparse precise technical details such as thin orbital contours make composition different, but no cluttered HUD. This is cinematic Interstellar-like gravitational beauty, expertly designed luxury web interface.

ART DIRECTION C — DEEP FIELD / INTERSTELLAR PASSAGE. This must feel entirely different from a decorative nebula or black hole: glacial ice-blue and silver against deep midnight black, clean quiet advanced-tech aesthetic. A vast receding corridor of fractured luminous cosmic arcs and translucent astrophysical dust spirals converges to a SMALL, extremely distant azure-white vanishing point around 42% horizontally and 48% vertically. It is an organic celestial space-time passage, not a manmade tunnel, not repeated perfect neon circles. Huge depth and scale; dusty blue stellar membranes and curved wisps become tinier with distance, tiny stars at many depths. Nearer thin silver-blue tendrils at outer top and bottom edges give parallax potential; central distant structures remain small and awe-inspiring. Foreground not overly crowded, no excessive speed streaks, no oversaturated cyan flood. On left headline at x~6%, y~29% in restrained white with second line pale ice blue; keep dark empty area under text. On right change form treatment to a crisp floating charcoal terminal panel with 10px corners, subtle hairline silver edge, small blue indicator dot near top, pale icy-cyan primary button with deep-black text and slender tab underline. More geometric and precise typography and spacing, sophisticated almost monochrome. Leave large expanses of dark space so the distant light feels immeasurably far away.
